notes.title: Happy Anniversary! New Chapter Coming In June!
notes.content:
Hi all,

It's been a year since Infinite Mana officially launched, and I just want to thank everyone who has supported me and the project! Thank you for your bug reports, suggestions, and requests. This game means a lot to me and I hope you're enjoying it.

The world of Arukea is very large and in your travels you have likely been to a great variety of places and met many people, but there are still many places left to be undiscovered. Places only mentioned by people or read about in books. I plan on doing more content for the game to illustrate more of the world, as well as tie up loose ends.

In this free new chapter, Dragonweaver, you will return to the Far West and head south, where storms are gathering. Visit the new city of [b]Sampada and meet its colorful denizens[/b], travel through the [b]picturesque Amrit Ghats[/b], and brave the [b]sands of Guradja Oasis[/b]. In this chapter you'll meet new races, speak with dragons, [b]unlock a new Guise[/b], and more! It will be the first part of a new storyline.

Without further ado, please enjoy the new trailer:

[previewyoutube=dq0rB1FFg1M;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you're as excited to travel to these far off lands as I was making this new chapter.

Feel free to join the Discord as well: [url=discord.gg/cT8dzvxycr]discord.gg/cT8dzvxycr[/url]

notes.title: Optimization, GP Pooling, And More!
notes.content:
Hi all,

The [b]optimizations from the Beta (Performance) build are now in Live and the Demo[/b]! You can read more about those changes in the last post [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1369970/view/4375895494746247360]here[/url]. Ongoing optimizations will continue to be made, but this is a big one, please check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/2e0cc7e82e5965ec9ba87582e92dfb8b63ff1bea.png[/img]

One of the most requested features is the ability to use excess GP somehow, because you can become capped at 999 quite quickly if you have a favorite Guise. Players have also said that it's no fun trying to get new characters up to speed when they have no GP to spend. Today's update attempts to fix both of these issues by [b]introducing a new feature: The GP Pool.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/4d5567cb6b4b328d764487d02d42c9ccd3dc983b.png[/img]

This [b]new feature allows you to dump your character's GP into a shared "Pool"[/b] that can be drawn from and used on other characters on any Guise you wish. GP can be dumped in a rate divided by 5 which allows for you to get a leg up on your Guises, but doesn't remove the need to collect GP completely.

Along with this update are a number of improvements to Guises, optimizations to many areas including overworld load times, and general bugfixes. Please feel free to join us on Discord if you have any questions or just want to talk about the game, the community is very warm and welcoming.

[b]If you were using the Performance build you can now change it back None[/b] to go back to the Live version which includes the same improvements as that build. Please note that the Performance build will likely become a more generalized Beta build at some point when new features are being tested, but may fall out of date with Live. I will make an update when there's something new to check out that's not quite ready for Live.

notes.title: Infinite Mana Optimization
notes.content:
Hi all,

I've been working for many months now trying to make sure the game is well optimized as best I can, but some people still suffer from low framerate and stuttering, and I want to make that a non-issue as best as I can.

[i]There is now a Performance build[/i] of the game which acts as a beta of sorts for these optimizations. Anyone that owns the game can opt into this and test it out. Many of the improvements are on the back-end, however [b]there is a new feature under the Visual options called Culling Distance[/b] that will allow players to change the number of objects/NPCs on-screen. The default is 60 tiles, so please try the 20 and 40 options and let me know if this new feature makes the game better for you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/9ac9baf08a47513f952694a23681a873241fb326.png[/img]
This is how you opt in. Just right-click the game in your library and go to the Properties.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/ae90ff1d4a47137b4ed914ea9ec9ddb95ff4084b.png[/img]
This is the option in-game.

I've seen improvements from 4-5 FPS up to 120 FPS with this new feature alone! Please check it out and let me know what you think. You should be able to swap to this build and play with your current save files, but [b]please please PLEASE back up your saves first just in case![/b]

notes.title: Moral Choices and Bugfixes!
notes.content:
Hi all,

Today's update brings some [b]additions to the Infamy system and character friendship values[/b] in Infinite Mana. I always felt the system could be a little more, and your feedback has only made me want to add to it. You will find new NPCs to interact with throughout the world which you can either help or hinder/harm which will raise or lower your [b]Outstanding Infamy[/b] - the choice is up to you! You will also gain Outstanding Infamy from being sent to jail. This system will pave the way for a future update in which your choices will play a larger role.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/670b2af06473bb249e01915aef1cb4633353110e.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Small changes to several Guises.
[*] Fixes for incorrect items, descriptions, and event placements.
[*] Various grammar/spelling fixes.
[*] Various performance fixes.
[/list]

And there are a few other things on the way though I do not have a timeframe for a few, I just want you to be aware that they are being worked on:

[list]
[*] The soundtrack will be out in a couple weeks!
[*] A performance build that may fix performance issues for many people.
[*] Linux and Mac builds.
[/list]

As always, a huge thanks to everyone in Discord who's been reporting bugs and giving feedback!

notes.title: Introducing Emblems! Sub-Guise System and Other Fixes

Hi all,

Today's update is a little more than just bugfixes. I'm slowly going through a list of requests and suggestions and a big one I've received is the ability to equip a Sub-Guise. I always enjoyed the feature in other RPGs with a class system but had some issues implementing it properly. There are some limitations to the system because the game is not balanced around the idea, but I think this will be a good compromise for those that would like a little build variety. I'm excited to see what kind of builds you can come up with! 

And now for the patch notes...

[list]
[*] Introducing Emblems! With this new system you can [b]equip Emblems that grant a select number of powers from your other Guises[/b]. This feature unlocks in Chapter 2 and can be accessed from Hexbox, just speak to the weird cat near the back.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/07ce84f093a06897bb252c0ef9cfa833345729b6.png[/img]
[*] Due to how Emblems work, [b]Badges are now considered Accessories[/b].
[*] There is now an option to [b]enable/disable godrays[/b] for performance or if you just plain hate 'em!
[*] Fixed an issue where Trickster skills would lock the game if targeting a defeated enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player couldn't find monsters in Solitude caves.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game was looking for an unused music file in Smileton.
[*] Fixed a couple issues where the player was teleported to an incorrect spot.
[*] Removed the floating fishing rod from the Weald. Whatcha fishin' for buddy?
[*] Various grammar/spelling fixes.
[*] Various performance fixes.
[/list]

Please let me know what you think of the new system and please enjoy your time in Arukea.

notes.title: Early Access! What Does It Mean?
notes.content:
Hi all,

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/be5fb258eb5fabd302e579132c4f698d5c2492fb.png[/img]

Infinite Mana is coming to [b]Early Access on Friday, June 16th, 2023![/b] But what does that mean exactly? Well, let's go over it together.

[u][b]What to expect:[/b][/u]

[b]A game made by a single developer:[/b] Since it's just me developing the game, things take time to implement and properly bug test (also, a huge shout out to the community who has helped bug test!). The game is a labor of love and I plan to make a wonderful experience through and through. Early Access grants me time and resources to fix bugs and implement features/assets.

[b]Bugs:[/b] Bugs are always rearing their head at the worst moments. If you have any issues or something just seems off, please let me know in the Steam forum or on Discord. If you face any progress-blocking issues, let me know and I will fix your save file ASAP.

[b]Placeholder Assets:[/b] Some of the music and graphics in the game are placeholder assets and will be slowly changed before release. The soundtrack is done by myself and [url=https://t.co/sDuyjypday]AdLib[/url], and it's currently about 50% complete. Things like User Interface and sprites are slowly being worked on to be the best they can be.

[b]Updates:[/b] Throughout Early Access, not only will the game be updated to fix bugs but to add content. Currently, the game features a prologue and two chapters to discover, but I plan on having 10 chapters in total, plus a post-game with new areas that wraps up story beats. A Chapter Update will be added periodically that features new areas, quests, main story, Guises, and more. Each of these chapters are fairly lengthy, anywhere between 3-8 hours long depending on the chapter and on how much you do, so expect quite a lot to do in-between releases.

[b]Beginning on Early Access, everything up to Chapter 2 will be available to play[/b], this includes:

- Around 10-15 hours of gameplay depending on if you do everything.
- Lengthy main story, as well as a multitude of sidequests.
- 4 Guises to unlock: The elemental magick-wielding Disciple, the beast-raising Tamer, the shape-shifting Warden, and the tricky Trickster! This is alongside the 4 base Guises you start with (Wanderer, Oracle, Rogue, and Beastmaster).
- Plenty of stuff to collect, fish to catch, and more diversions.

With that all being said, I do have a roadmap I want to show off!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40987702/8a3af1ef1a901a7e6cd4b6b59054c5d4e702a8d9.png[/img]

As you can see, chapters will be released throughout the year with lots of new content to play through. Each chapter will take around 3-6 hours to complete. There is a chance I will speed up the cadence of releases, however I don't want to make any promises. Once something is set in stone, I will update the roadmap and announce it through Steam. [b]The plan is to get the game finished and released as soon as possible[/b], so it's unlikely that every chapter will be made available throughout Early Access, but it will all be made available at release.

That's Early Access in a nutshell. I plan to be active on Steam with bug-fixes, game updates, and work-in-progress posts, so please, join me on this journey! Thank you for following the game, and I can't wait for you to play and show you everything that Infinite Mana has to offer. [b]Feel free to reach out via the forums on Steam or on Discord, or even Twitter if you have any issues[/b].

~ Hyd
